title: Towards Safer Pretraining: Analyzing and Filtering Harmful Content in Webscale Datasets for Responsible LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety, toxicity, and harmful content filtering (e.g., hate speech, misinformation, and illegal activities).
